constraints: New properties apply only to the current process and are not saved with the form; they override (for this process) whatever was set in the Design environment's Form editor.
If minHeight/maxHeight are omitted while resize is True, the values set in the Design environment (if any) are used instead.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, whether the current form can be resized vertically and, if so, its minimum/maximum allowed heights in pixels.

jointConstraints.rule: minHeight and maxHeight are only meaningful when resize is True; if resize is False there is no need to pass them (the form's height becomes fixed regardless of any values given).
